Manufactured by [Mfg] Corp.

entries.text: A [Dice.1d4+1]0 horsepower Spirit zero point energy generator replacement engine for Motorcycles or Scooters. It is made to replace the electric engine and part of the battery system in the hybrid engine system. This increases Speed and Handling by 1. It also increases payload by 50% (which is conceptual, because SR does not use encumberances or payloads). Costs included in new vehicle (as a Modification it costs 500 NY, 8T, 1 day, Shop). Manufactured by [Mfg] Corp.

entries.text: A [PistolWatt] watt Spirit zero point energy generator modification for a pistol. It fits inside the grip, and needs a modification made to the electric firing and barrel (Threshold 16, 8-hours, Shop). It enhances powder burn when used with a new propellant (it is not backwards compatible). The new powder becomes the standard. Range is increased +20%, and Damage is increased +3P. Costs 50 NY. Manufactured by [Mfg] Corp.
